prompt.text:
Implement a CommonJS module exporting exactly `{ createBody, advanceBody, getCorners }` for immutable rectangular-body calculations. `createBody(options)` requires a plain object containing finite `x`, `y`, positive `width`, positive `height`, and positive `mass`. Optional finite `vx`, `vy`, and `angle` default to zero. Optional restitution defaults to 0.25 but must be within 0 through 1, including an explicitly supplied zero. Invalid input throws `TypeError`. Return a frozen body. `advanceBody(body, force, dt)` requires a valid body, a force object with finite `x` and `y`, and finite `dt >= 0`. It must use semi-implicit Euler integration: new velocity equals old velocity plus force divided by mass times dt; new position equals old position plus the new velocity times dt. Angle and all dimensions remain unchanged. Return a new frozen body without mutation. `getCorners(body)` returns four fresh `{ x, y }` objects for the rectangle's corners in clockwise order starting at the unrotated top-left corner, rotated around the body's center by `angle`. Empty or malformed arguments throw `TypeError`.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
